description: Apply to a job with a chosen resume. For Jobiba-native jobs the first call returns a preview and sends nothing; the application is submitted, with the resume attached as a PDF snapshot, only when called again with confirm=true. For jobs that use an external employer form it returns Jobiba's apply link (it opens the employer's form for the signed-in user), a resume download and a details kit instead, and with markApplied=true records the user's own application in their tracker.

confirm.description: Only true after the user explicitly approved sending this application.

markApplied.description: External jobs: record that the user applied on the employer site.

resumeId.description: Resume to send (from tailor_resume_for_job or list_my_resumes).

name: apply_to_job
title: Apply to a job
